scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
......

[Mingmin]
^0C0CF2Pop quiz hot shot: Art thou my servant?^000000
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
^0C0CF2小測驗，大人物：汝可是我的僕人？^000000

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oh, {0} its you... it is good you have ed, I was bored.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哦，是你啊，{0}......你回來得正好，我都快無聊死了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Question {0}! I was practising because new servant is coming soon.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
第{0}題！新僕人很快就要來了，我正在練習呢。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Welcome! {0}...

[Mingmin]
Hello {0}.

[Mingmin]
A stranger. This place is supposed to be for Eden Group Members only.
I'm in need base level ^FF0000111 - 120^000000 adventurers to help my research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
陌生人？這裡應該只允許樂園團成員進入。
我需要基礎等級^FF0000111～120^000000的冒險者協助研究。

scripts.text: [Mingmin]
scripts.translation: [明敏]

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
(Wow...)
The Geneticist is muttering to herself.
scripts.translation: 那位基因學者正低聲自語。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
...

[Mingmin]
......

[Mingmin]
^0000ffA question: Art thou my servant?^000000
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
^0000ff有個問題：汝可是我的僕人？^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What's this lady talking about?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（這位女士在說什麼？）

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Answer me!
Art thou my servant?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
回答我！
汝可是我的僕人？

scripts.text: I am not.
scripts.translation: 我不是

scripts.text: You be trippin'?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Thou art not? Splendid...because I deigned that any servant of mine would have more dignity.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
不是？那太好了......我可不想讓一個毫無尊嚴的人做我的僕人。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Well, non-servant...What are you looking for here?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
好吧，既然不是僕人......你來這裡找什麼？

scripts.text: Nothing in particular.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼特別想找的

scripts.text: Quests! Who are you?
scripts.translation: 我來做任務！你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
That is acceptable, I hope ye find what ye seek.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這樣也好，願汝能找到想找的東西。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oh me? I am ^E51BD8Busaner Mingmin^000000 and I'm researching monsters by request of the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我嗎？我是^E51BD8布薩內爾·明敏^000000，受樂園團委托研究魔物。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I used to collect fungus and mold alone at my mountain lab. Since then, I joined a group looking for new monsters...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
以前我獨自在山裡的實驗室採集真菌和黴菌。後來，我加入了一個尋找新魔物的團隊......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
With all my experience, they actually made me a professor here at the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
憑著這些經驗，他們居然讓我在樂園團裡當教授。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Anyways, there is a pressing task I must complete, please excuse me for a moment.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
總之，我有件急事得處理，失陪片刻。

scripts.text: No~ I'm {0} remember?
scripts.translation: 不~我就是{0}，還記得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oh I have met you before, living in a house full of fungus seems to cause memory loss.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哦，我見過汝。看來住在滿是菌類的房子裡，確實會讓人忘事。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Who were you again?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝剛才說自己是誰來著？

scripts.text: Eden Group requests and research
scripts.translation: 樂園團的委託與研究

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Ah, that I do remember.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
啊，這個我倒記得。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I am collecting information on the flora and fauna of Midgard for the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我正在替樂園團收集米德加爾特的動植物資料。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The intention is to scientifically catalog and itemize the dangers of the world. I do not like this idea personally.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
他們想用科學方法整理並記錄這個世界的危險。不過，我個人並不贊成這種做法。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Theory will only take you so far in this world.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
在這個世界裡，光靠理論可不夠。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Morever, an adventurer who travelled outside of Rune-Midgarts should be experienced enough to know themselves.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
而且，曾在盧恩·米德加爾特王國以外旅行的冒險者，應該早已積累足夠經驗，也瞭解自己的能力。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
This is ^ff0000my opinion^000000 only so do not concern thyself.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這只是^ff0000吾個人的看法^000000，汝不必在意。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Well, after all this talking I need to take a rest. My feet are rather tired.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
說了這麼久，我也該歇歇了，腳有些累。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Where was I? I just finished talking about the Eden Group's duty to protect others from danger.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我說到哪裡了？剛才講的是樂園團保護人們免受危險的責任。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
To protect more people, I think they need adventurers who have experienced things first-hand.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
若想保護更多人，我認為需要那些親身經歷過危險的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
So we need those brave or foolhardy enough to venture out to gather info in the field.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
所以我們需要勇敢，甚至有些魯莽，願意親自到野外收集情報的人。

scripts.text: Sounds dangerous... when can I start?
scripts.translation: 聽起來很危險......我什麼時候能開始？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Talk to me in a second and we'll get going.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
稍等片刻，再來找我，我們就出發。

scripts.text: Waddya mean new servant?
scripts.translation: 你說的新僕人是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oh...sorry, I meant squire...
I mean adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
啊......抱歉，我是想說侍從......
我是說冒險者......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Sorry, the fungus in my home has been getting quite rampant.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
抱歉，我家裡的菌類最近長得太瘋了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I found Rohtert is working here when I arrived with a request from Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我帶著樂園團的委託來到這裡時，發現羅特特也在這裡工作。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Thou has met him prior to now? I do have a history with him.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝以前見過他？我和他確實有些過節。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The guy with white hair by the entrance. You should drop by if you are interested, he is managing level 100-110 adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
就是入口旁邊那個白髮男人。感興趣的話可以去找他，他負責接待100～110級的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Anyways, he had been working here so he knows better than me. I just came by to get advice.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
總之，他在這裡工作了很久，比我熟悉情況。我只是來向他請教。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
That was not that difficult so..
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
那件事倒不算難......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Silly adventurers are going to come and ask me, ^ff0000'My queen, treat me like a naughty servant!'^000000
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
那些傻乎乎的冒險者會跑來求我：^ff0000“女王陛下，請把我當成不聽話的僕人，好好管教我！”^000000

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
 For some reason there aren't many people lining up to assist me yet.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
不知為何，到現在都沒多少人排隊來幫我。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I think it requires ^ff0000bravery^000000 to take a new request.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我覺得，接下這項新委託需要^ff0000勇氣^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Enough dilly-dallying, I want to make a contract with someone who really craves adventure.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
別再磨蹭了，我想找個真正熱愛冒險的人簽訂契約。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Maybe {0} I'll let you be my servant if you are interested in doing this Eden Group request for my research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
也許，{0}若汝願意幫我完成這項樂園團研究委託，我就讓汝做我的僕人。

scripts.text: Request to research monsters
scripts.translation: 研究魔物的委託

scripts.text: Make small-talk
scripts.translation: 閒聊

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I think I already told you that I am looking for an adventurer with more experience for my monster research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我想我已經說過了，我正在尋找經驗更豐富的冒險者，協助我研究魔物。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oh, you want to help me with my research?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哦，汝想幫我做研究？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
We need some more information on the following monsters. Choose.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我們還需要了解以下魔物的更多資訊。請選一種。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The request for researching monsters seem to easy for you.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這項魔物研究委託對汝來說似乎太簡單了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Contract is terminated. {0} reward for completed research. ^FF0000I will delete incompleted research from your quest list.^000000
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
契約已終止。完成研究可獲得{0}獎勵。^FF0000我會把未完成的研究從任務列表中刪除。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Do you want to know something? I am busy researching.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝想了解什麼？我正忙著研究呢。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It is fine day for researching. It is always fun to talk to someone of sufficient intelligence.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
今天真是適合研究的好日子。和聰明人交談總是令人愉快。

scripts.text: [Mingmin]
scripts.translation: [明敏]

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It is because this mission has very dangerous requests.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
因為這些委託都非常危險。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Lets see. If you can handle all requests from rohtert standing there, then I will reconsider.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
讓我想想......如果汝能完成那邊羅特特交代的所有委託，我就重新考慮。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I will reconsider if you turn to base level 111.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
等汝的基礎等級升到111級，我就重新考慮。

scripts.text: She seems to be waiting for a ^FF0000special signal.^000000 What do you want to do?
scripts.translation: 她似乎在等一個^FF0000特別訊號^000000。你想怎麼做？

scripts.text: Make a heart with two hands.
scripts.translation: 用雙手比個愛心

scripts.text: Dance around like a crazy person
scripts.translation: 像瘋子一樣跳舞

scripts.text: Wink at her
scripts.translation: 向她眨眼

scripts.text: Whistle at her.
scripts.translation: 對她吹口哨

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
What's that for?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
那是什麼意思？

scripts.text: Hmm, she didn't go for that.
scripts.translation: 嗯，她好像沒理會。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
This signal!?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這個訊號？！

scripts.text: Say nothing and nod...
scripts.translation: 沉默地點點頭...

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
......

[Mingmin]
Question...! Art thou my servant?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
問題......！汝可是我的僕人？

scripts.text: Yes, my leige...
scripts.translation: 是的，我的君主......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Well, that's all settled then! Thou shalt signeth this form.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
很好，那就這麼定了！汝在這份表格上簽字吧。

scripts.text:
[Contract]
A - adventurer shall not talk back to Busaner Mingmin and will not complain under any circumstance.
scripts.translation:
[契約]
A - 冒險者不得頂撞布薩內爾·明敏，無論發生什麼都不得抱怨。

scripts.text:
[Contract]
B - adventurer shall proceed to complete the request for Busaner Mingmin as quick as humanly possible.
scripts.translation:
[契約]
B - 冒險者必須儘可能迅速地完成布薩內爾·明敏交付的委託。

scripts.text:
[Contract]
C -This contract is terminated on the day that a request of the adventurer is completed.
scripts.translation:
[契約]
C - 冒險者完成委託之日，本契約即告終止。

scripts.text:
[Contract]
D - this contract shall be confidential except between the adventurer and Mingmin under ^FF0000penalty of death.^000000
scripts.translation:
[契約]
D - 除冒險者與明敏本人外，任何人不得知曉本契約內容，違者^FF0000處以死刑^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Don't worry too much. The Unions require it you know. Just sign on the line that is dotted.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
不用太擔心，這是公會規定的。只要在虛線上簽名就好。

scripts.text: Sign the contract.
scripts.translation: 簽署契約

scripts.text: Take time to think.
scripts.translation: 再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You can take your time....
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
慢慢考慮也無妨......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Did you sign it?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
簽好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Haha! I feel much better now.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哈哈！我現在舒服多了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Thank you for accepting the strange contract. Looking forward to working with thee.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
謝謝汝願意接受這份奇怪的契約。期待與汝合作。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I was careful for public requests because I have to be polite to adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我接待公開委託時一直很謹慎，畢竟得對冒險者客氣些。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I tried to be poilte . But it just doesn't suit my personality.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我也試過講禮貌......但那實在不像我的個性。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Thou shouldst be more careful...Did you notice something about the pen you signed with? There were ^FF0000orange shiitake mushroom spores^000000 on it.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝該更小心些......沒注意到簽名用的筆有什麼特別嗎？上面沾著^FF0000橙色香菇孢子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
If the spores get in your bloodstream, you might grow mushrooms inside of your own body.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
孢子若進入血液，汝的身體裡可能會長出蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It takes quite a long time so do thine best. I might give you the antidote if you do well.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這需要不少時間，汝得好好努力。表現得好的話，我或許會給汝解藥。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
All right we became quite familiar now. So. Shall we get start to work?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
好了，我們現在也算熟悉了。那麼，開始工作吧？

scripts.text: Glastheim related requests
scripts.translation: 葛拉斯海姆相關委託

scripts.text: Thanatos tower related requests
scripts.translation: 達納托斯塔相關委託

scripts.text: Ash Vacuum related requests
scripts.translation: 異世界相關委託

scripts.text: Mingmin's personal request
scripts.translation: 明敏的個人委託

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I heard something is going on in Glastheim. Monsters are afoot.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我聽說葛拉斯海姆出事了，那裡有魔物出沒。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
We need to research monsters in Thanatos tower.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我們需要研究達納托斯塔裡的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The research for Ash Vacuum is just beginning. So there are still many thing to study!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
異世界的研究才剛起步，還有許多東西值得探索！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
This request is for my personal research. I research for Eden Group and they support me to hire people assisting my research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這項委託是為了我的個人研究。我替樂園團做研究，他們會出資聘人協助。

scripts.text: [Mingmin]
scripts.translation: [明敏]

scripts.text: Raydric Research
scripts.translation: 研究幽靈劍士

scripts.text: Khalitzberg Research
scripts.translation: 研究卡利斯格

scripts.text: Wanderer Research
scripts.translation: 研究邪骸浪人

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You can find Raydric in the west entrance or on the 2nd floor of Glastheim.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
葛拉斯海姆西側入口和二樓都能找到幽靈劍士。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
How do you feel dealing with tough monsters? Good documents and good experience to you as well.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
對付這些強大的魔物感覺如何？這既能留下研究記錄，也是很好的歷練。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Something is happening in Glastheim. And that clue is in Raydrics that is information I have.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
葛拉斯海姆似乎發生了什麼事。我掌握的情報顯示，線索就在幽靈劍士身上。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Khalitzburg will be found in west entrance of Glastheim.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
葛拉斯海姆西側入口附近能找到卡利斯格。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
How do you feel of dealing with tough monsters? Good documents and good experience to you as well.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
對付這些強大的魔物感覺如何？這既能留下研究記錄，也是很好的歷練。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Maybe Khalitzburg is linked to what is happening in glastheim so lets research it.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
卡利斯格或許和葛拉斯海姆的異變有關，研究一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Wanderer will be found if you enter from the north entrance and go to big entrance in the middle of the road in Glastheim.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
從葛拉斯海姆北側入口進入，沿著道路走到中央的大門附近，就能找到邪骸浪人。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Wanderer is the representative of Glastheim. It is dangerous but cool!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
邪骸浪人堪稱葛拉斯海姆的代表魔物。危險是危險，不過挺酷的！

scripts.text: [Mingmin]
scripts.translation: [明敏]

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Raydric's research is going well. It is better off having more samples to research.!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
幽靈劍士的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就好了！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Khalitzburg's research is going well. It is better off having more samples to research!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
卡利斯格的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就好了！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Wanderer's research is going well. It is better off having more samples to research!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
邪骸浪人的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就好了！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I need information and document no matter what happens. Come back to me after dealing with ^FF000030 Raydric^000000's.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
無論如何，我都需要情報和記錄。處理掉^FF000030只幽靈劍士^000000後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The experience you learn by fighting with monsters will be a good record for the research!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
與魔物戰鬥的經驗也能成為很好的研究記錄！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I need information and document no matter what happens. Come back to me after dealing with ^FF000030 Raydric^000000's.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
無論如何，我都需要情報和記錄。處理掉^FF000030只幽靈劍士^000000後回來找我。

scripts.text: Take the request.

處理完魔物後回來找我吧。我需要把你們的經歷都記錄下來。

scripts.text:

I need information and document no matter what happens. Come back to me after dealing with ^FF000030 Khalitzburg's^000000
scripts.translation:

無論如何，我都需要情報和記錄。討伐^FF000030只卡利斯格^000000後回來找我。

一隻一隻地處理完後，再回來告訴我經過吧。這些都是重要的記錄......

[Mingmin]
I need information and documents no matter what happens. How about dealing with ^FF000030 Wanderers^000000.
scripts.translation:

無論如何，我都需要情報和記錄。請討伐^FF000030只邪骸浪人^000000。

[Mingmin]
The experience you learn by fighting with monsters will be a good record for the research!

與魔物戰鬥的經歷也能成為很好的研究記錄！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It will be a good research. Come back after dealing with ^FF000030 Wanderers^000000.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這會是很有價值的研究。討伐^FF000030只邪骸浪人^000000後回來找我。

scripts.text: Quit

Please tell me the story after dealing with them one by one. They will be important documents...
scripts.translation:

一隻一隻地處理完後，再回來告訴我經過吧。這些都是重要的記錄......

scripts.text: Ancient Mimic research
scripts.translation: 研究狂暴邪惡箱

scripts.text: Deathword research
scripts.translation: 研究死亡文字

scripts.text: Owl Baron research
scripts.translation: 研究鶚梟男爵

scripts.text: Bloody Page research
scripts.translation: 研究染血的書頁

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It is not far if you move from Juno or Hugel to Thanatos or Abyss lake.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
從朱諾或毀葛出發，去達納托斯塔或深淵湖都不算遠。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You did good work today!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
今天做得不錯！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You will see them often at thanatos tower or abyss lake. They are not generous with their drops but that is not important to finishing this request.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
達納托斯塔和深淵湖附近經常能遇見它們。雖然掉落物不多，但不影響完成這項委託。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Thanatos tower will be more dangerous than you thought. You might want to organize a party before going there.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
達納托斯塔比你想像的更危險，最好先組個隊再去。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Thank you so much. This will be great research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
非常感謝，這會是很有價值的研究。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
That is the reason why I chose Thanatos tower to research. Do not be surprised. This one is an old book that became a monster!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這就是我選擇在達納托斯塔研究它的原因。別驚訝，它是一本變成魔物的古書！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You can meet it if you climb the tower according to the rumors. For me, well I've never been up there.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
聽說爬上塔就能遇到它。至於我嘛，從來沒上去過。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Safely back!? Eden Group will be happy.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你平安回來了？！樂園團一定會很高興。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Personally I have no interest in this monster but it was requested from the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我個人對這隻魔物沒什麼興趣，不過這是樂園團交代的委託。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Wow. It is so curious. It is exciting!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哇，真讓人好奇，太令人興奮了！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
3rd floor of thanatos has Deathword monsers that drop these bloody pages.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
達納托斯塔三樓有死亡文字，會掉落這些染血的書頁。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The fact that I decided to travel to Thanatos has the reason. Haha, I heard that I can get Bloody Pages from Deathword monsters.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我決定來達納托斯塔是有原因的。哈哈，聽說能從死亡文字身上拿到染血的書頁。

scripts.text: [Mingmin]
scripts.translation: [明敏]

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Ancient mimic research is going well. It is better off having more samples for the research!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
狂暴邪惡箱的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就好了！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Deathword's research is going well. It is better off having more samples for the research!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
死亡文字的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就好了！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Owl Baron's research is going well. It is better off having more samples for the research!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
鶚梟男爵的研究進展順利。要是能多收集些樣本就好了！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I like old books! Okay I need to analyze this. Bloody Pages! Please bring more tomorrow or the day after tomorrow. Anytime!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我喜歡古書！好了，我得研究一下這些染血的書頁。明天或後天再多帶一些來吧，什麼時候都行！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Do not complain! It will be a good experience for you!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
別抱怨！這對汝來說也是一次很好的歷練！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The experience you learn by fighting with monsters will be a good record to research!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
與魔物戰鬥的經歷也能成為很好的研究記錄！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I can not find any connection in two areas but they keep coming up so it is worth researching. Come back after taking care of ^FF000030 ancient mimic^000000.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我想不出這兩個地區之間有什麼關聯，不過它們總是一起出現，值得研究。處理掉^FF000030只狂暴邪惡箱^000000後回來吧。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
If you possibly get a good drop from them, you know right? Do not forget about me!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
要是從它們身上打到什麼好東西，可別忘了我哦！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I want to research this so take this request please!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我很想研究這個，拜託你接下委託吧！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I will give you a reward...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我會給汝報酬......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I want to research the background of those creatures. Please check ^FF000030 Deathwords^000000.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我想調查這些生物的來歷。請去看看^FF000030只死亡文字^000000。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Please take care of them one by one. Those books contain precious history of Midgard so I want to research them.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
請逐一處理它們。那些書承載著米德加爾特的珍貴歷史，我想好好研究一番。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The guy with blue hat went to the top but I didn't bother to follow.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
那個戴藍帽子的男人爬上塔頂了，不過我懶得跟上去。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Anyways, There will be enough reward for sure.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
總之，報酬肯定不會少。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Please take care of ^FF000020 Owl Barons^000000. It will help other adventurers to explore Thanatos tower.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
請討伐^FF000020只鶚梟男爵^000000，這樣其他冒險者探索達納托斯塔時會更安全。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It does not mean I am not going to research them. The more documents the better research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我可沒說不研究它們。資料越多，研究成果越好。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I think if thou shalt collect 20 of these it should be enough for my research. It's barbaric, but it is a job!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝若能收集20份這些材料，應該就足夠我研究了。雖然做法有些野蠻，但這就是工作！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
There will be enough reward for sure.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
報酬肯定不會少。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I know they're gross and bloody but just imagine the centuries of stories preserved in those pages...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
它們看起來又噁心又血腥，不過想想那些書頁裡儲存著數百年的故事......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Can you please get me 20 ^FF0000Bloody Pages^000000? I will be happy if there is one useful bookshelf we can use when you bring them back.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
能幫我收集20張^FF0000染血的書頁^000000嗎？要是能拿回來，我就能用它們整理出一排有用的書架。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Please, I really want to research this.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
拜託了，我真的很想研究這個。

scripts.text: Dark Pinguicula research
scripts.translation: 研究沉醉於魔力的捕蟲堇妖

scripts.text: Nepenthes research
scripts.translation: 研究豬籠草

scripts.text: Naga research
scripts.translation: 研究沉醉於魔力的那迦

scripts.text: Centipede Larva research
scripts.translation: 研究變異蜈蚣幼蟲

scripts.text: Cornus research
scripts.translation: 研究飛馬

scripts.text: We know the magic power of the horn we saw that day.
scripts.translation: 我們知道那天見到的角蘊含著魔力。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I think this research is easy. They are not too dangerous from the initial reports I've received.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這項研究看起來不難。根據我收到的初步報告，那些魔物並不算危險。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Good job! keep helping my research. I still have so much to do.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
做得好！繼續幫我做研究吧，我還有很多事情要處理。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It is the monster living northwest of the Allied Forces Camp. I am not interested in going myself but the request was already paid for and I may as well research them.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
那種魔物住在遠征營地西北方。我自己不想去，不過委託費已經付了，正好可以順便研究它們。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It could be a simple request or tough request. Try to find friends if you are in trouble. That is adventure too!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這項委託可能很簡單，也可能很棘手。遇到困難就找朋友幫忙，這也是冒險的一部分！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Good job! Keep assisting with my research. I still have so much to do.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
做得好！繼續幫我做研究吧，我還有很多事情要處理。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Do you know the monster name as mandragora? There is similar monster to the east of the expedition station. I am sure it will be related for researching monsters.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝知道曼陀羅魔花嗎？遠征營地東邊有一種相似的魔物，我想這對魔物研究會有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You take care of those addicted to magic powers, I have no interest.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
那些沉醉於魔力的魔物就交給汝處理吧，我沒興趣。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Good. Keep helping my research. I have too many to check out.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
很好，繼續協助我的研究吧。我還有太多東西要檢查了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Please take care of 30 ^FF0000Naga^000000 monsters northwest of the expedition station.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
請到遠征營地西北方討伐30只^FF0000沉醉於魔力的那迦^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oh... No Lets take a deep breath. For me, I want to exterminate more than 20 for research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哦......先深呼吸。為了研究，我想多消滅20只以上。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oh. Okay. You do not need to explain.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哦，好吧，不用解釋。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Yuck! It is very disgusting. Look at me. It is so creepy I wanted to survey it because I was interested in Nepenthes. But I hate bugs with lots of legs...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
真噁心！光看著就讓人發毛。我本來對豬籠草感興趣，才想調查這些東西，可我最討厭多足的蟲子了......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I need to research those flying horse creatures so please help me out.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我需要研究那些飛馬一樣的魔物，幫幫我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
How was it ? Is that monster easy for adventurers to get?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
怎麼樣？這種魔物對冒險者來說好對付嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I found the monster that satisfies my research needs and helps adventurers to gain experience from the Eden Group. It is not weak or fierce monster either.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我找到了一種適合研究、又能讓樂園團冒險者獲得經驗的魔物。它既不弱小，也不算兇暴。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Yes this one! It is worth doing. Thank you for taking this request.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
對，就是這種！值得研究。謝謝汝接下這項委託。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I am still researching but I hope to extract magic power from magical touched things.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我還在研究，希望能從受魔力影響的物品中提取魔力。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
This is why I accepted the request for this from Eden Group. Find 20 ^FF0000Mystic Horn^000000 from the Cornus monsters.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
所以我才接下樂園團的這項委託。請從飛馬身上收集20個^FF0000魔力之角^000000。

scripts.text: [Mingmin]
scripts.translation: [明敏]

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Pinguicula dark's research is ongoing. Please come back to me next time.!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
沉醉於魔力的捕蟲堇妖還在研究中，下次再來找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Nepenthes's research is still ongoing. Please come back to me next time!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
豬籠草的研究還在進行中，下次再來找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Naga's research is still ongoing. Please come back to me next time.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
沉醉於魔力的那迦還在研究中，下次再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I'm still researching the Centipede Larva. Please come and help me next time.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我還在研究變異蜈蚣幼蟲，下次請再來幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Cornus's research is still ongoing. Please research for other adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
飛馬的研究還在進行中，請把這項委託讓給其他冒險者吧。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I'm still researching the Mystic Horns you brought. Quite interesting. I can beat blue hat soon.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我還在研究你帶來的魔力之角，很有意思。我很快就能打敗那個藍帽子了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It is north west from the Allied Forces Camp. It is not that far so hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
它們就在遠征營地西北方，距離不遠，快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Hunt ^FF000030 Dark Pinguicula^000000. Battling it will provide some good research materials.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
請討伐^FF000030只沉醉於魔力的捕蟲堇妖^000000。和它們戰鬥能收集到很好的研究材料。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Be careful and safe.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
小心行事，注意安全。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It is east of the Allied Forces Camp. It is not that far so hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
它們就在遠征營地東邊，距離不遠，快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Why don't you hunt 30 ^FF0000Nepenthes^000000? Their vines crawl up everywhere so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
去討伐30只^FF0000豬籠草^000000如何？它們的藤蔓到處蔓延，小心點。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The request like this satisfies me and the Eden Group. Be careful though.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這樣的委託對我和樂園團都有好處。不過還是要小心。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Please take care of 30 Naga monsters northwest of the expedition station.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
請到遠征營地西北方討伐30只沉醉於魔力的那迦。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I have no interest in it but it bothers my time to research the other monsters that I actually want to study. So I want the number of them to be reduced.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我對它們本身沒興趣，可它們佔了我的時間，讓我沒法研究真正感興趣的魔物。所以我想減少它們的數量。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Please do your best. This request is also important to unlock additional research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
盡力完成吧。這項委託也是解鎖後續研究的重要一環。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Be careful. And they're east of the expedition station.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
小心點，它們在遠征營地東邊。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Come back after 20 ^FF0000Centipede Larva^000000 are exterminated. Can you imagine how big they became? Just the thought makes my skin crawl.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
消滅20只^FF0000變異蜈蚣幼蟲^000000後再回來。想想它們長大後的樣子，我就渾身發毛。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I'm sorry that I didn't do it myself. I'm not ashamed to admit that it's too disgusting for me.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
抱歉，我沒親自去做。對我來說，那實在太噁心了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Of course, It will help your adventurers too in some way I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
當然，我想這項委託多少也能幫到冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I believe that Adventurers will handle Cornus in the future, so go out and deal with ^FF000030 Cornus^000000 so I can research that viability.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我想以後冒險者會需要對付飛馬，所以請去討伐^FF000030只飛馬^000000，讓我研究一下這是否可行。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
This could be a revolution for Eden Group Adventurers. Be positive with this request please.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這或許能給樂園團的冒險者帶來突破。請認真完成這項委託。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It will be useful for me and adventurers, right?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這對我和冒險者都有幫助，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I think I can use this horn for good things. It is easy to get. I will let you know later.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我覺得這種角能派上大用場，而且很容易取得。之後再告訴汝。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Ye gain experience and I get research material. Good deal right? Excellent!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝能獲得經驗，我也能拿到研究材料，一舉兩得！太棒了！

scripts.text: Ancient Mummy research
scripts.translation: 研究古代木乃伊

scripts.text: Geffenia survey
scripts.translation: 調查吉芬尼亞

scripts.text: Juperos survey
scripts.translation: 調查朱佩羅斯

scripts.text: Fragment and Rusty Screw collecting.
scripts.translation: 收集碎片與生鏽的螺絲

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
If I finish researching, the first thing I'm going to do is eat a 10 year aged strawberry pudding...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
研究結束後，我最想做的就是吃一塊陳放了十年的草莓布丁......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Did a good job. Fantastic strawberry pudding is not easy to make. Trust me. I will let thee taste it someday soon.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
做得好！要做出絕妙的草莓布丁可不容易，相信我。改天一定讓汝嚐嚐。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Things are supposed to go bad. Most of them but people want to keep and preserve food for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
東西總會變質，大多數食物都是如此，可人們還是想辦法長期儲存。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I do not expect a lot because it is very dangerous and not easy to access.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
那裡太危險，也不容易到達，我沒抱太大希望。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You are more talented than I thought. If you found a tact, I will request to you for next time as well. This research is up to you.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝比我想像的更有天賦。若找到門路，下次我還會把研究委託交給汝。這項研究就拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
This is pre-survey for precious research because Geffenia is easy to access.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
吉芬尼亞很容易到達，可以先去做一番調查，為後續的重要研究做準備。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
There is one more reason why many adventurers are sent to Juperos and that is my real request.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
還有個原因讓樂園團派了這麼多冒險者去朱佩羅斯，那才是我真正想委託的事。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You are not confused? I still do not know yet. What is the difference? Anyway good job.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝沒糊塗吧？連我自己都還沒弄明白呢。有什麼區別嗎？總之做得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The remains of ancient, Juperos is mysterious. There are lots of ^FF0000secrets^000000. But this is yet again a simple monster research survey.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
朱佩羅斯是一處神秘的古代遺蹟，藏著許多^FF0000秘密^000000。不過這次也只是簡單調查魔物。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Thank you. You will appreciate me if my research is completed.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
謝謝汝。等我的研究完成後，汝就會知道這份幫助有多重要。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You can find ^FF0000Fragment and Rusty Screw^000000 in juperos everywhere. Most of the monsters have it.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
朱佩羅斯到處都有^FF0000碎片和生鏽的螺絲^000000，大多數魔物身上都能找到。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Juperos is intense and mysterious. When he showed up, It seems like it is not Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
朱佩羅斯充滿危機，也很神秘。那裡出現的東西，看起來完全不像米德加爾特的產物。

scripts.text: [Mingmin]
scripts.translation: [明敏]

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Ancient Mummy's research is still ongoing.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
古代木乃伊的研究還在進行中。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Geffenia's research has just started. It is beginning so go slowly. Lets research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
吉芬尼亞的研究才剛起步，慢慢來，一點點調查吧。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
They all look the same for me.	I should research harder.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
在我看來它們全都長得一樣......看來我得再多研究研究。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I will make anything better than you imagine.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我會做出超乎汝想像的東西。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
To finish my research I need you to hunt some Ancient Mummy.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
想完成研究的話，還得請汝去討伐幾隻古代木乃伊。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Have you even seen the bandage that Ancient Mummy are wound up in? They last even for centuries at a time.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝見過古代木乃伊身上纏著的繃帶嗎？據說能儲存好幾個世紀。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I guess it is rotten but we can make big money if this research goes well. Preservatives can make a strawberry pudding that does not go bad with time.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
繃帶看起來是腐爛了，不過研究成功的話就能賺大錢。再配上防腐劑，草莓布丁就不會變質了。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
This research is necessary so that I can make my strawberry pudding.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我得做完這項研究，才能做出草莓布丁。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
This request is attempting to an adventurer who used to enjoy it. Simple! Fun! Worthy experience!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這項委託是給喜歡冒險的冒險者準備的。簡單！有趣！還能獲得寶貴經驗！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The request starts from how to find a way in. Please take a look what kind of monsters are in there. first of all, start by hunting ^FF000010^000000 Incubus, Succubus and Violy. Then lets research the details later.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
先想辦法找到入口，再調查裡面有哪些魔物。第一步，請討伐^FF000010^000000只惡魔侍者、惡魔女僕和薇歐莉，之後再慢慢研究。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Try to start from Geffen fountain, if you want more information.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
想了解更多的話，不妨從吉芬噴泉附近開始找線索。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
If you go to Juperos? I wish you to take a request about ^FF0000Venatus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
要去朱佩羅斯的話，幫我調查一下^FF0000凡娜圖^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The monster ^FF0000Venatu^000000 in juperos has 4 types of colors. Which means there are four types of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
朱佩羅斯的^FF0000凡娜圖^000000有四種顏色，也就是說共有四種不同的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I thought they are the same because they look the same. Is it only me? I can not distinguish. Hunt 30 of each Green, Orange and Blue ones just to be sure.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
它們看起來都一樣，我還以為是同一種呢。難道只有我分不出來？保險起見，請分別討伐30只綠色、橘色和藍色凡娜圖。

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It wil not be easy to be alone. But looking for a fellow for adventure is what an adventurer does.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
一個人行動確實不容易。不過找同伴一起冒險，本來就是冒險者該做的事。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I know it is not easy but I wish thee to take this request. Please.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我知道這不容易，但還是希望汝接下這項委託。拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It is core research. I need to know who he is. That will be amazing. Can you bring me 10 ^FF0000Fragment^000000 and 20 ^FF0000Rusty Screw^000000?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這是項重要研究。我得弄清楚那個東西是什麼，這一定會很有意思。能帶回10個^FF0000碎片^000000和20個^FF0000生鏽的螺絲^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Take the request.
scripts.translation: 接受委託

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I do not know how many drops you can carry but I want as many as you can. May I ask you to bring 10 ^FF0000Fragment^000000 and 20 ^FF0000Rusty Screw^000000?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
不知道汝的負重還裝得下多少，不過我希望能收集越多越好。能帶回10個^FF0000碎片^000000和20個^FF0000生鏽的螺絲^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
There is nothing I can do because these are the rules of the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
這是樂園團的規定，我也沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
There is someone who strongly wishes you to solve your request.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
有人非常希望汝能完成這項委託。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It is a little bit inconvenient. I will read to you politely ^FF0000again^000000 in public.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
雖然有點麻煩，不過我會^FF0000再^000000當眾禮貌地念一遍給汝聽。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Anyway {0} thank you for helping me start my research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
總之，{0}謝謝汝願意幫我開始這項研究。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Do not worry, I will treat you like a slave if we meet outside of Eden Group or if you tell anyone I was nice to you.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
放心，若我們在樂園團外碰面，或者汝把我對汝很好的事告訴別人，我就把汝當奴隸使喚。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Just because I'm being nice now doesn't mean we're automatically friends though.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我現在對汝好，不代表我們就成了朋友。

scripts.text: ^0000ffFriends^000000 story
Something to research
scripts.translation: 研究相關的事

scripts.text: Orange beard gluey mushroom...
scripts.translation: 橙色香菇黏液......

scripts.text: Finish conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I found a familiar face since I arrived to Eden Group with this request. ^ff0000Rohtert^000000 is the one.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
帶著這項委託來到樂園團後，我發現一個熟面孔。那就是^ff0000羅特特^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I found a familiar face since I arrived to Eden Group with this request. Do you see the guy ^FF0000Rohtert^000000 with white hair near the entrance?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
帶著這項委託來到樂園團後，我發現一個熟面孔。看到入口附近那個白髮的^FF0000羅特特^000000了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I used to talk to Rohtert from time to time while researching. There was a lot of things to talk about ever since I left the guild.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
研究期間我偶爾會和羅特特聊天。自從離開公會後，我們有很多話可以聊。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Researching these magic items there is more to it than just having them in your possession.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
研究這些魔法物品，光把它們拿到手可不夠。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Well do you remember my personal research I mentioned before? It is not easy even I tried to develop...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
對了，還記得我之前提到的個人研究嗎？我嘗試開發它很久了，但一直不順利......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
... orange shiitake gluey mushroom?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
......橙色香菇黏液？

scripts.text: [Mingmin]
scripts.translation: [明敏]

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I research monsters. Especially their features, personality, spleens, locations and relationship with other monsters. Etc.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我研究魔物，尤其是它們的特徵、性情、種類、棲息地，以及彼此之間的關係等等。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Orange mushroom? I do not know.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
橙色蘑菇？我可不知道。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Do not worry. Ok, maybe worry because mushrooms could be growing in your body. I will get rid of it if you help me to research. It will be dangerous if it takes longer time.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
別擔心......不對，或許該擔心一下，因為你身體裡可能會長出蘑菇。只要幫我研究，我就會幫你清除孢子感染。拖太久可就危險了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Please help me there are so many things to research.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
還有很多東西要研究，快來幫幫我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I hope you have a good time
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
祝汝玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I used to join clubs that researched rare monsters. I heard it became a guild and anyway I met him there.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
以前我參加過研究稀有魔物的社團。聽說後來發展成了公會，我就是在那裡認識他的。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I look younger but I am like his sister. There was so many things that happened in that club. However, I shouldn't go on and on about it. I might tell you later when we have time.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我看起來年輕，其實和他情同姐弟。那個社團裡發生過很多事......不過我就不多說了，有空再告訴汝。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Now that he's grown up... well he used to follow me calling me his sister. By the way where is the blue hat guy who used to stick to him like glue. Did they have a fight?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
他現在也長大了......以前他總跟在我身後，叫我姐姐。對了，那個總黏著他的藍帽子呢？他們吵架了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
That blue hat guy... He used to annoy me even at the club. If I see him again I just might smack him...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
那個戴藍帽子的傢伙......在社團時就很煩人。要是再讓我遇見他，我可能會揍他一頓......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I think the guild is still around since there were so many members even when I was there.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我離開時公會裡有那麼多成員，我想它現在應該還在。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I even heard that blue hat guy made himself a guild master. Imagine that fool being a master oh ho ho ho.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我還聽說那個藍帽子自己當上了公會長。想像一下那個傻瓜當會長的樣子，呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
My plan so far is like this. Extracted magic from the Mystic Horn is compressed by the Fragments and Screws. Then I will input the ancient information which was written in the Bloody Pages.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我目前的計劃是這樣：先從魔力之角中提取魔力，再用碎片和螺絲將它壓縮，最後輸入染血書頁上記載的古代資訊。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I'm hoping to create some type of small hand-held storage device.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我想做出一種小型的手持儲存裝置。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I wil be rich if I complete this research! I am sure.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
只要研究成功，我就能發財了！我確定！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I tried to make a magic device that you can hold in your hand.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我試著製作一種可以拿在手裡的魔法裝置。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
No. I can not give up for this. I will make it.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
不，我不會放棄的，一定要把它做出來。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Let me see. It might be dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
讓我看看......這可能有危險。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You helped me to research so let me help you! I will get rid of your mushroom spore infection.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝幫我做了研究，我也來幫汝吧！我會清除你身上的香菇孢子感染。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
......

[Mingmin]
...hee hee...

[Mingmin]
Hmmph, You are so naive. Did you believe it? Sticky.. some kind of mushroom is growing in your body? Hahaha
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哼，汝真天真。真的相信了嗎？什麼黏糊糊的蘑菇會長在你身體裡？哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It was just a joke. A little joke between friends.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
只是個玩笑，是朋友之間的小玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I am sorry if you are upset. You made it too easy...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
如果汝生氣了，我很抱歉。誰讓汝這麼好騙呢......

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You are funnier than I thought. Do not worry. That mushroom does not exist.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
汝比我想像的有趣。別擔心，根本沒有那種蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You finished researching about {0}. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你已完成{0}的研究，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I will delete {0} research from request list.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我會把{0}的研究從委託列表中刪除。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You finished researching about {0} and {1}. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你已完成{0}和{1}的研究，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You finished researching about {0}. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你已完成{0}的研究，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I will delete {0} and {1} research from request list.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我會把{0}和{1}的研究從委託列表中刪除。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I will delete {0} research from request list.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我會把{0}的研究從委託列表中刪除。
